critical_code_review_comments: RightDashboard.jsx getSetQtys() (L154-167) correctly derives a tab-INDEPENDENT unified set qtys array by taking the longest qty array across the active mirror (s.qtys) AND every component's stored state ((it.state||{}).qtys), so a third tier added on one component while another component tab is active is now discoverable.

RightDashboard.jsx buildItems() (L168-211) in the isMatched branch now broadcasts setQtys (multiplied by pcsPerSet) to every component's itemQtys, ignoring per-component qtys[] gaps. This is the correct fix and matches the engine's top_qtys semantics for matched-set.

Verified Per-Item Slot 2 now contains all 3 components at qty 300 (Display Base 300/532 lbs, 60ct. Tray 300/435 lbs, Header 300/176 lbs) and Per-Job Scenario 2 header reads 'Qty 300' with combined 1,143 lbs — both spec-required behaviors confirmed in the live served bundle.

The 'Batch freight quote failed ... 502' banner from iteration_40 is no longer surfaced — updateFreight() MP batch loop's retry-only-error-if-zero-rates logic appears to suppress non-fatal partial-failure noise.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Matched Set unified-qty broadcast bug is fully resolved as of this iteration. If retesting, open SA-260604-165816-COPY, click btn-freight-dash → dash-update-rates, wait for [data-testid='freight-uts-spinner'] to clear (~60-120s real UTS calls), then validate dash-per-item-slot-{0,1,2} headers ('Qty 100/150/300') each list all 3 components, and dash-per-job-scenario-{0,1,2} headers read 'Qty 100/150/300' (not 'Scenario 3'). Combined weight for the qty-300 scenario should be ~1,143 lbs.
rca of the issue: Previous iterations (39, 40) failed because the broadcast read s.qtys directly — which is only the ACTIVE BOM tab's mirror — so a 300 tier added while one component was active never propagated to the other components' stored state.qtys. The current fix in RightDashboard.jsx getSetQtys() takes the longest qty array across the active mirror AND every component's stored state, then buildItems() broadcasts that unified array to every component (× pcsPerSet) regardless of per-component gaps. FreightDashModal PerItemTable hdrLabel uses row.setQty and PerJobTable scHdr uses sc.setQty to render the 'Qty N' label even when underlying per-component qtys would otherwise be non-uniform. All paths verified working end-to-end in the running bundle.
